scope: People management: users, roles/permissions, groups, admin rights, targets, productivity/utilization, user rates, on/offboarding, MFA/SSO, audit logs, Clio for Enterprise/Operate, HR-like capacity/leave

features.name: Five standard roles plus custom roles
features.where: Settings > Roles and Permissions (or Clio Admin > Roles & Permissions)
features.what: Every user must hold a role. Five built-in roles act as templates; custom roles are built by picking a template then toggling permissions per area. Built-in roles carry some permissions that cannot be switched off.
features.plan_tier: Custom roles: top tier only per CA/AU plan pages (CA 'Signature': unlimited custom roles; AU table hints a cap of 2 on a middle tier); Starter has none. US tier mapping unconfirmed.

features.name: Administrator role
features.what: Full access to firm settings, user and role management and firm data; non-configurable powers include bank and trust account actions (view/create/edit/delete/export/manage transactions). Only admins change other users' permissions.

features.name: Multiple roles per user, most permissive wins
features.what: A user can hold several roles; effective rights are the union (most permissive role wins). Custom role edits apply immediately.

features.name: Timekeeping permission scope (all / accessible matters / own)
features.what: View and manage rights for activities each scoped to all activities, activities on matters the user can access, or only their own.

features.name: Billing rate visibility per user
features.where: Settings > Manage Users > user > Billing rate visibility
features.what: Per-user setting All / Own / None controlling whose hourly rates a user sees when entering time; only admins can set it for others.

features.name: Billing, Accounts and Reports permissions
features.what: Separate permissions gate bills, bank/trust accounts and reports; financial permissions decide whether Transactions and Bills subtabs show on matters and contacts. Reports permission is a single checkbox.

features.name: Firm Feed restricted to administrators by default
features.where: Firm Feed tab; custom role > Firm Settings > view firm feed
features.what: A firm-wide activity stream; only admins see it unless a custom role grants the feed permission.
features.plan_tier: Plans with custom roles to delegate

features.name: Groups
features.where: Settings > Groups (older path: Groups, Permissions, and Job Titles > Groups)
features.what: Admin-defined sets of users used for matter permissions, calendar sharing and client custom rates. Archiving a group does not remove it from matters, calendar shares or contact rates.

features.name: Matter permissions (everyone vs specific users/groups, max 20)
features.where: Matter > Edit > Matter permissions > Firm users with access
features.what: Matter open to everyone by default or limited to specific users/groups, capped at 20 entries combined. Any user can set it while creating or editing a matter.

features.name: Admin view of restricted matters and bulk permission update
features.where: Matters table filters; bulk actions > Update matter permissions
features.what: Admins can list matters they are restricted from and bulk-change matter permissions; bulk edit can be delegated through a custom role (needs Edit matter properties).

features.name: Admin Console (Clio Admin) across products
features.what: Central page for users, licences and roles across Clio products; bulk invite several emails with the same roles, groups and licences; bulk allocate/remove product licences. Being rolled out in phases.

features.name: Invite and bulk import users
features.where: Settings > Manage Users > Invite / Bulk Import; Invited tab to resend
features.what: Invite by email with attorney or non-attorney type, roles and groups; CSV import with email, first/last name and subscription_type (Attorney/Non-attorney).

features.name: Deactivate user and licence handling
features.what: Deactivation keeps past activities and tasks and the user stays on matters until reassigned; calendar entries hidden. The licence stays billed until removed; reactivation does not restore add-on licences (e.g. personal injury).

features.name: Reassign work from a user
features.what: Admin bulk-moves tasks (and per the deactivation article, matters and calendar events) from one user to another; only open/pending matters and not-past-due tasks; work on closed matters cannot move.

features.name: Clio Grow separate permission layer
features.what: Grow users are Normal or Admin, separate from Manage roles; Grow licence removal needs Clio Support; Manage licence changes mirror to Grow.

features.name: Multi-factor authentication administration
features.what: Admins see each user's MFA status, require MFA per user, invite users to enable it, and reset a user's MFA (not the primary subscriber's). Help text says MFA became mandatory in January 2026 for remaining users at next login.

features.name: Single sign-on (SAML)
features.where: Manage: Settings > Security & Compliance > Firm Security > Single Sign-on; Grow: Settings > Account
features.what: Verify the firm's email domain (minutes to 72h), add an IdP configuration (e.g. Okta with step-by-step SAML setup) and mark a default configuration.

features.name: Login activity and device sessions
features.where: Settings > Security & Compliance > Log In Activity / Sessions
features.what: Admins review sign-ins of all users (IP, last access, last active, session length) filtered by user/date; users see their own sessions and can force log out all; email alert on unrecognised device.

features.name: Personal performance target
features.what: Each user sets default billing rate, annual billings target, working days per year and fiscal year end (per currency); drives the dashboard's target-vs-actual billable bar and utilization denominator.

features.name: Firm Dashboard utilization / realization / collection
features.what: Firm KPIs for managers/admins/users with reports permission: utilization = billable hours / available hours (8h day, working days from personal target), realization, collection; by activity date; LTR benchmarks shown.

features.name: Productivity by user and by client reports
features.what: Per user time and expense amounts split unbilled/billed/total including discounts (lawyer productivity report); by-client share of billed activity.

features.name: Detailed Annual Report (target vs actual)
features.what: Compares a user's yearly target with billed+unbilled billable time (flat/contingency included, non-billable and expenses excluded); needs billing and reports permissions and unrestricted rate visibility.

features.name: Task productivity report
features.what: Counts each user's upcoming, overdue and completed tasks.

features.name: User default rate and rate tables
features.where: Settings > Manage Users (rate); Settings > Billing > Rate tables
features.what: User default rate is lowest in the hierarchy (custom > flat > matter > client > activity custom > user). Rate tables group per-user rates by segment and attach to matters/contacts.

features.name: Manage AI personal metrics and AI reports
features.where: Reports > Manage AI gem; AI Launchpad > Ask a Question
features.what: Natural-language report building and questions about personal targets; respects existing permissions; admin enables it. A secondary review cites a 90-day AI event log.

features.name: Third-party app authorization as the user
features.what: Apps use OAuth 2.0 auth code; access = app scopes intersected with the authorizing user's own role permissions.

features.name: Clio for Enterprise division
features.product: Clio for Enterprise (Operate, Vincent, Library, Docket)
features.what: Launched Oct 2025 for large firms and legal departments; Clio Operate is the renamed ShareDo (acquired March 2025), launched in North America in 2026.

features.name: Clio Operate permission sets, teams and work-type roles
features.where: Admin > Security > Global Permissions; Modeller > Participant Roles
features.what: Global permission sets (what a user can do) assigned to users or teams with inheritance; per work-type participant-role permissions; access to work and personal data lockable and audited; Active Directory integration.

features.name: Clio Operate workload allocation and availability
features.what: Shows how busy people and teams are; automated, queue or decision-supported manual allocation; approvals tied to user competencies and authority limits; user availability records.

gaps.feature: Bulk invite / CSV import with attorney vs non-attorney type
gaps.proposal: Add 'Invite users' action accepting a pasted list or CSV (email, name, role, licensee number, supervising licensee); agent pre-fills licence status from the law society directory and flags non-licensees needing a supervisor before the invite is sent; owner approves.

Add 'Offboard' action on user-detail: wizard lists open matters (responsible/team), work items, timers, unsubmitted time, trust signatory status, calendar events; agent proposes successor per item from team and workload; requires responsible-lawyer approval for matter handover and owner approval for signatory removal; ends sessions and revokes tokens immediately; keeps history and rates. Include closed matters (Clio cannot move them).

gaps.feature: Licence / seat counts and billing per user type
gaps.proposal: We price per firm; keep a 'seats in use' read-only counter on user-list but no per-seat billing. State this in versus page.

Make MFA mandatory for all users (no off switch); user-list shows MFA method and last verification; 'Reset MFA' action needs a second admin or owner approval and is written to access-audit; owner MFA reset never by admin alone.

gaps.feature: SAML/OIDC single sign-on with domain verification
gaps.proposal: Add screen 'sign-in-settings' (/settings/sign-in): IdP config (OIDC first, SAML later), verified domains, enforce SSO toggle with owner break-glass local login, session lifetime and idle timeout, IP allowlist (optional). Changes gated by owner approval.
Already shows sessions; add firm-wide 'Sign-ins' tab on access-audit (IP, device, time, result) with filters and CSV, plus unrecognised-device email to the user.

gaps.feature: Groups used across matters, calendars and client rates
gaps.proposal: Add 'Teams' entity (named groups, e.g. 'Real estate team') usable in matter team, calendar sharing and rate tables; archiving a team prompts to replace it everywhere it is used (fix Clio's leftover-group problem).
Add capability 'rates.view' with levels none/own/all in the matrix, so reports and time entry hide others' rates unless granted; Clio leaks rates through the reports permission.

gaps.feature: Personal performance target incl. annual billings target and working days
gaps.proposal: Add fields: fiscal year end, currency, standard day length (default 7.5h for Ontario practice, configurable), and let a timekeeper propose their own target that the managing lawyer approves.
Define utilization denominator explicitly (working days x day length minus approved leave) and show it; add optional benchmark line, never a fabricated benchmark.

gaps.feature: Productivity by user / client and task productivity reports
gaps.proposal: Ensure per-person task counts (upcoming/overdue/completed) appear on work-reports; dollar productivity sits on time/utilization.

Clio Manage has no leave feature (none found). Add 'Availability' entity (person, from, to, type: leave/part-day/court, delegate) feeding workload capacity, timekeeper target pro-rating and deadline coverage; agent warns when a deadline owner is away and proposes the delegate.

gaps.feature: Approvals tied to competencies and authority limits (Clio Operate)
gaps.proposal: Add per-person authority limits (e.g. max write-down %, max trust withdrawal, practice areas cleared to approve) on user-detail; gates check them in addition to role.
Add allocation rules: queue per practice area, auto-assign by capacity and competency, agent proposes assignee with reason; human confirms for client work.

gaps.feature: AI report questions about personal targets (Manage AI)
gaps.proposal: 'Explain shortfall' covers it; ensure answers respect the rates.view capability.
Keep one role plus time-boxed extra grants; show effective rights with source of each on user-detail (already in spec).

corrections.our_claim: access.json clio_compare 'Firm feed': 'Firm-wide activity feed visible to administrators by default; others need a custom role permission.'
corrections.truth: Supported by Clio help snippet. Keep, cite help.clio.com/hc/articles/9200279456667.

corrections.our_claim: access.json clio_compare 'Permission model': custom roles 'on higher plans'
corrections.truth: Supported for CA/AU: CA top tier (Signature) advertises unlimited custom roles; AU table suggests a capped number on a middle tier; Starter has none. US tier mapping unverified, so say 'top tiers (CA: Signature/Elite)'.

corrections.our_claim: access.json clio_compare 'Intake CRM users': 'Grow has its own user permissions separate from Manage (verify current model)'
corrections.truth: Confirmed: Grow users are Normal or Admin, separate from Manage roles, though the new Admin Console manages roles and licences across products and Manage licence changes mirror to Grow.

corrections.our_claim: access.json clio_compare 'Apps and API': apps 'act as the user who connected them (verify)'
corrections.truth: Confirmed in substance: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code; access is the app's scopes combined with the authorizing user's role permissions.

corrections.our_claim: access.json clio_compare 'Break-glass and reviews': 'No built-in emergency access or periodic access certification found (verify)'
corrections.truth: Still none found; but admins can list matters they are restricted from and bulk-change matter permissions, which is a de facto override. Phrase as 'admin can re-grant themselves access; no logged break-glass or review'.

corrections.our_claim: versus page: 'Admin access: Admin sees almost everything'
corrections.truth: Mostly right but imprecise: Clio admin has full settings/user/data rights and non-configurable bank/trust account powers; admins can be removed from a matter's permission list but can see and bulk-change permissions of matters they are restricted from. Suggest 'Admin holds every right and can re-grant themselves any matter'.

corrections.our_claim: access.json clio_compare 'Reports': reports permission exposes colleagues' productivity and rates even without billing permission
corrections.truth: Partly unproven: Detailed Annual Report needs billing AND reports permissions and unrestricted rate visibility; Firm Dashboard is visible to users with reporting permission. Keep claim only for dashboard/productivity reports and mark 'verify' for rates.

corrections.our_claim: time.json clio_gaps 'Billable hour goals / productivity dashboard' path 'Dashboard > billable hours target'
corrections.truth: Target is set per user at Settings > Profile > Personal Performance (also via the gear on the dashboard target); includes annual billings target, working days and fiscal year end; utilization assumes an 8-hour day.

screenshots_index.shows: Custom role creation steps (help article with screenshots)
Dashboard billable hours target with working-days gear (blog with images)
Firm Dashboard marketing page with KPI imagery

open_questions: Exact names of Clio Manage's five standard roles (only Administrator confirmed; help pages 403).
US plan tiers (EasyStart/Essentials/Advanced/Complete vs new Starter/Core/Signature/Elite) that include custom roles, SSO and rate tables.
Whether Clio can enforce SSO-only login, idle timeout or IP allowlists (no evidence found).
Whether Clio has a true audit log of permission/setting changes beyond Firm Feed and login activity, and whether it exports.
Whether Reassign Work moves matters and calendar events or only tasks (sources disagree).
Clio Operate availability/capacity detail (only article titles seen).
Is there any Clio Manage leave/out-of-office feature? None found.
